Main text in one block: small Roman numeral headings XC, XCI, XCII and XCIII, each set on its own line; paragraphs and italic passages; a centred part heading "De Effectibus appellationis". Small-type footnotes (a, b) under the text. Bottom right: an abbreviated reference "b.t.c." and at the foot the gathering signature "E 3". No margin notes.

p.i: iud.c.directa39. & c.fuanobis 65.h.t. Spec.Eod. §. quoties in pr.Marant.h t.n.280.

main_text.p: Nisi forte nouum aliquod grauamen, per tertiam illam sententiam, appellanti illatum fuerit.

p.i: Quotiescunq; enim tale quid noui infertur, toties etiam appella-tionis remedium locum habet.
Marant.h.t. n.281. arg.c. omnis 3. & c.ad Romanam 8. & c.quoties. 2. q. 6.

main_text.p: Hinc jam quaeritur, si quis tertio ita condemnatus sit, nec tamen adhuc jus suum consecutus,{a} neq; etiam de nouo iterum grauatus, utrum tali sententiae acquiescere debeat? Minime: licet enim ulterius non possit appellare, nihil tamen impedit, quo minus de nullitate sententiae agat.{b}
{a} Nec enim utiq; melius semper pronunciat, qui nouissimus sententiam tulit L.1. in prin.ff.h.t. {b} Marant.d.t.n.283. Vant.in trac. de Nullitat.cap. quoties & int.quod temp. de nullit.

Verum enimuero omnia haec, ne fraus Iurisdictioni Impe-riali fiat in Camera hodie mutata sunt. Nec enim ibi Exceptiotrium conformium sententiarum objecta contra appellatio-nem attenditur: sed ea postposita nihilominus appellatio ad-mittitur.
main_text.head: De Effectibus appellationis
main_text.p: Effectum appellatio duplicem habet. Suspensiuum & De-volutiuum. Suspensiuum in eo, quia appellatione interposi-ta, siue ea recepta sit siue non sit,{a} medio temporis interuallo à Iudice, qui sententiam dixit, nihil neq; innouari, neq; attentari, neq; ad executionem perduci potest.{b}

p.i: {a} Siquidem receptafuerit appellatio, quia recepta est: si verò non est recepta, ne praeiudicium fiat, quoad deliberetur, vtrū recipiendafit appellatio, an non. l. vn. in pr. ff. nih. innov. appel. Duar.

page.notes: Uncertain readings: "65.h.t." in the top line may be "6s.h.t." (marked as printed); "fuanobis" is doubtful; "Exceptiotrium" appears to have no hyphen at the line end and may be a printing error; "conformium" is doubtful; "L.1." and "Gail.l." are doubtful. The final "b.t.c." is treated as the reference for footnote b and is not a catchword. Printed hyphens at line ends are kept. Long s is written as s throughout. The bare Roman numerals XC to XCIII are written as paragraphs, following the rule for bare numbers.
